# PRINTFY 3D

> PRINTFY 3D is a 3D-printing shop in Cairo, Egypt. It offers ready-made gifts, décor and accessories, plus custom 3D printing. The website is available in English and Arabic. Prices are shown in EGP; delivery is available across Egypt.

Catalog details, stock, options, and prices can change; check the live product pages before answering. The STL calculator is an approximate mesh estimate, not a slicer-confirmed quote. Contact PRINTFY 3D on WhatsApp at +20 10 63870873 or by email at printify3d.eg@gmail.com.
